title: Sliding window: the largest sum of 3 in a row
summary: On [2, 1, 5, 1, 3, 2] with a window of 3, each slide adds one value and drops one; the best window is 5 + 1 + 3 = 9.

beats.title: Three in a row
beats.narration: Which three neighbouring numbers add up to the most? Checking every group from scratch repeats work.
